hits.title: Adib Alkhalidey | Comme les Mongols à Baghdad
hits.content: Following Québécois Tabarnak and Des putes et des voleurs—both winners of the Comedy Show of the Year award at the ADISQ Gala, a first in 45 years to win two years in a row—Adib Alkhalidey returns with Comme les Mongols à Baghdad.  | This new show is about transmission. The transmission of meaning, knowledge, wounds, fears, contradictions, and impulses that span an era that sometimes seems to have lost faith in its own ability to pass anything on at all. Reflecting his branching train of thought, the show unfolds through themes as varied as tax evasion, political corruption, the nightmare of putting children to sleep, the House of Wisdom in Baghdad, Jesus, and the reality of blended families. By tackling the most sensitive, intimate, or taboo subjects of our time, Adib Alkhalidey seeks less to provide answers than to reveal what emerges when we dare to face certain truths head-on. Driven by a rare freedom of expression—likely amplified by sleep deprivation and the questionable honesty of exhausted young parents—the show ultimately transforms this chaos into something strangely lucid, as if all these scattered branches secretly stemmed from the same tree. Comme les Mongols à Baghdad is a deeply funny show, at times brutal, at times unsettling, but always driven by a sincere desire to bring together what the times are determined to keep apart.  | ["1h30 without intermission","French"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: La Tribu"]

hits.title: Engelbert Humperdinck | The Celebration Tour
hits.content: Following a global career renaissance, Engelbert Humperdinck is set to bring The Celebration Tour to Montréal. Marking his landmark 90th birthday on May 2nd, the "King of Romance” offers you a memorable and intimate evening.  | Proving that age is merely a number, the 90-year-old icon continues to deliver powerful 90-minute sets to sold-out audiences worldwide. For this concert, you can expect an evening that honours an unparalleled legacy while looking firmly toward the future. In addition to his definitive signature hits, you will also get to hear some fresh new material!"The stage is my home," declares Humperdinck. "Canada has always been a highlight of my world tours, and I am thrilled to share this 90th-year celebration with the fans in Ontario and Quebec who have been with me… from the beginning through every chapter."With more than 140 million records sold and a recent surge in popularity driven by soundtracks like Marvel’s Moon Knight and Netflix’s The Umbrella Academy, these shows represent an exceptional opportunity to experience a living legend at the crowning of his historic "victory lap."Engelbert’s hits include Release Me, After the Lovin’, Spanish Eyes, The Last Waltz, There Goes My Everything, Am I That Easy to Forget, Quando Quando Quando and  A Man Without Love.  | ["1h30-40 without intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Rubin Fogel Productions"]

hits.title: Renaud symphonique: 50 ans de carrière!
hits.content: Renaud will be in Montreal to celebrate his 50-year career during a grand tribute evening at Salle Wilfrid-Pelletier. | For the occasion, an eclectic and daring lineup of Quebec artists will come together to honour Renaud and his remarkable career, accompanied by the Orchestre national de jazz and its 35 musicians, under the musical direction of Antoine Gratton.Different voices, generations, and artistic worlds, united by a shared desire: to celebrate Renaud and, in their own way, bring 50 years of songs to life.Featuring special guest appearances by Isabelle Boulay and Diane Dufresne, Betty Bonifassi, Daniel Boucher, Émile Bourgault, Édith Butler, France Castel, Luc De Larochellière, Gaële, Antoine Gratton, Keith Kouna, Yann Perreau, Marie-Jo Thério, Mara Tremblay et Édouard Tremblay-Grenier will revisit the songs that have marked the artist’s remarkable career.“Mistral gagnant,” “Morgane de toi,” “Dès que le vent soufflera,” “Laisse béton,” “En cloque,” “Hexagone”… Songs that have spanned generations and that, for this occasion, will take on a new dimension through arrangements specially crafted for this grand celebration.Renaud will be in the audience to witness this immense tribute paid to him by the artists and the Quebec audience.After 50 years of songs, poetry, humour, rebellion, and tenderness, this evening will be an opportunity to rediscover his world in a new light and to celebrate the songs that are now part of our collective memory. | ["2h20 with intermission"] | ["Stage Direction: Yann Perreau","Artistic Direction: Luce Rozon","Musical Direction: Antoine Gratton","Orchestra: Orchestre national de jazz","Interpretation: Isabelle Boulay, Diane Dufresne, Betty Bonifassi, Daniel Boucher, Émile Bourgault, Édith Butler, France Castel, Luc De Larochellière, Gaële, Antoine Gratton, Keith Kouna, Yann Perreau, Marie-Jo Thério, Mara Tremblay et Édouard Tremblay-Grenier","Production \/ Presentation: Agents Doubles Productions"]

hits.title: Their Master’s Voice with John Malkovich
hits.content: Their Master’s Voice is an impressive and unclassifiable show starring a true legend, actor John Malkovich. In this international production set in 1725, he is joined on stage by two opera singers, an actress, baroque musicians, and a 12-voice choir. | John Malkovich, known worldwide for his unique personality and voice, plays the famous Nicola Porpora, composer of 40 operas and singing teacher to the two most dazzling castrati of their time, Farinelli and Caffarelli. Brutally confronted with their egos, Porpora explores with them the limits of creation: what art allows us to say or not to say, to do or not to do. The characters oscillate dangerously between these two poles, on the verge of provocation.  This role is perfectly suited to John Malkovich, an iconoclastic artist who has appeared in more than 70 films, including Dangerous Liaisons, in which he played the unforgettable Valmont, and Being John Malkovich, in which he played a satirical version of himself. Always on the lookout for daring projects, he now finds himself in Their Master's Voice, an original production combining brilliant repartee, flamboyant costumes, and the greatest arias of the Baroque era's castrati.  Commissioned by the Monte Carlo Opera, Their Master’s Voice premiered in 2024 in Vienna and was a triumph at the Royal Opera of Versailles in Paris, among other venues. It is being presented in Quebec as part of a world tour.  The show is the brainchild of Michael Sturminger, a director whose passion is to build new bridges between classical music and contemporary theater. Sturminger and Malkovich, who share a keen artistic vision, have collaborated in the past, notably on the 2014 film Casanova Variations. Their Master’s Voice, a rare theatrical event, is a brilliant fusion of baroque opera and witty theatricality, sure to delight those who have always dreamed of seeing the great John Malkovich on stage.   | ["1h30 without intermission","English"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Productions Martin Leclerc"]

hits.content: A series of brief portraits set to the stage, with eight protagonists chosen for their unique lives and their original storytelling. | Last chance to see the show! Individuals from very different backgrounds — none are actors — who form many ties between them. Their voices, recorded live, magnified with enveloping sound design and coupled with their presence on stage, preserve the strength and authenticity of spontaneous words that cannot be performed again.With Pas perdus | documentaires scéniques (Steps Lost and Found: Stage Documentaries), Anaïs Barbeau-Lavalette and Émile Proulx-Cloutier explore our relationship to memory, transmission, language, what we carry inside us, and the room we make for joy. hits.title: Guy Nantel | Bienveillant
hits.content: While the news is overflowing with explosive topics, strong opinions, and contradictions — all so typical of our times — comedian Guy Nantel returns with a brand-new show bearing a rather intriguing title: Bienveillant.  | Yes, you read that right. Bienveillant. Not exactly the word you'd instinctively associate with a comedian known for his blunt honesty, critical eye, and uncompromising sociopolitical humor. Let’s just say the title sets the tone! Nantel has always been that distinctive voice who dares to say out loud what others only think in silence. With his sharp insight and well-aimed irony, he exposes our collective flaws, contradictions, and the major debates of our era — much to the delight of his audience. With this seventh show of his career, Guy Nantel keeps doing what he excels at: disarming us, surprising us, and above all, making us laugh out loud. But one question remains: how does he manage to do all that with kindness? We’ll just have to see… and more importantly, hear for ourselves. Admit it — it sounds promising!  | ["1h30","French"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Entourage Spectacle"]

hits.title: Mariza | The Star of Fado
hits.content: To the great delight of Montréal audiences and the Portuguese community, the celebrated fadista Mariza returns to the Maison Symphonique for a concert eagerly awaited for more than eight years. An icon of 21st-century Lusophone music, she has established herself as one of the most powerful and moving voices on the international stage.  | Since Amália Rodrigues, few Portuguese artists have enjoyed such a brilliant international career. Mariza has graced the world’s most prestigious stages, earning critical acclaim and receiving numerous international awards and distinctions. Born in Mozambique and raised in Mouraria, the historic Lisbon neighbourhood closely linked to the birth of fado, Mariza grew up in a world where voices, guitars, and stories of life shaped the soul of this music. From an early age, she embraced this heritage and carried it into a universal dimension. Gifted with an extraordinary voice and natural charisma, she first captivated Lisbon before quickly becoming an international phenomenon. For more than two decades, Mariza has performed on the great stages of the world, from North America to Asia, from Europe to Latin America, carrying with her the soul and sensibility of Portugal. Her remarkable career includes more than fifty platinum records, several Grammy Award nominations, and critical recognition that places her among the great voices of world music. Heir to the tradition of fado while resolutely looking toward the future, Mariza embodies a living vision of this musical heritage. On stage, her presence and the depth of her interpretation transform every performance into a rare experience, where the emotion of fado is shared in all its truth.  | ["1h15 with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Traquen'Art"]

hits.title: JF Otis | Avec plaisir!
hits.content: Comedian JF Otis officially presents his very first one-man show: With Pleasure! This outstanding storyteller, a proud representative of the Rimouski region (more precisely, Saint-Anaclet-de-Lessard) and self-proclaimed "specialist in making average decisions," has truly found his place on stage with this first show, where he cultivates the pride of his regional identity with disarming charisma.  | His incredible gift of the gab and his natural yet irresistible magnetism allow him to attract a wide audience who can't help but embrace him and his authentic humor.With a phenomenal social media presence, JF Otis has accumulated an impressive total of nearly 225,000 followers across his platforms, including 130,000 on TikTok, where his comedy clips have garnered over 3.6 million likes. Building on this viral popularity, JF Otis is now brilliantly transposing the richness of his universe onto the stage with his first one-man show. The delicious humor that made him a success, whether it's his hilarious advice on life as a couple, his personal and family anecdotes, or his heartfelt tributes to demanding professions, are at the heart of Avec plaisir! (With pleasure!). Always unifying and deeply engaging, the comedian subtly explores a variety of topics with an accessible and straightforward approach in a classic stand-up routine."This show is an invitation to spend quality time together, since it's Avec plaisir (With pleasure) that I take the stage every night to share my stories, my observations... and above all, to hear you laugh. You should also know that my stories are often inspired by my family, a veritable gallery of characters! My parents, my sister, my grandmother, my uncle... they fuel my humor every day." Honestly, I'm far from being the funniest in my group, now it's up to you to judge!" - JF OtisJF Otis, who co-wrote the show with comedian and veteran author Simon Delisle, invites the audience to a warm, festive atmosphere, as if we were all around a campfire, sharing anecdotes with an old friend! | ["French"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Agence Comico"]

hits.title: Loreena McKennitt | The Mask and Mirror – Anniversary Tour
hits.content: In fall 2026, award-winning Canadian singer/songwriter, Loreena McKennitt, will be commemorating the 30th anniversary of her album, The Mask and Mirror, with an extensive tour of Eastern Canada. Widely acclaimed for its ‘cross-cultural fertilization’, the album weaves together Celtic, Spanish and Moroccan influences.  | Loreena will be accompanied by musical companions Caroline Lavelle on cello, Brian Hughes on guitar, Hugh Marsh on violin, Dudley Phillips on bass and Robert Brian on drums. The first set each evening will feature fan favourites, while the second set will include every song on the album.McKennitt proclaims, “This is a milestone anniversary in my career, and I look forward to celebrating it at home.”  Her eclectic Celtic blend of pop, folk and world music has sold more than 14 million albums worldwide, and her recordings have achieved Gold, Platinum and multi-Platinum status in 15 countries, on four continents.  | ["English"] | ["Cello: Caroline Lavelle","Guitar: Brian Hughes","Violin: Hugh Marsh","Bass: Dudley Phillips","Drums: Robert Brian","Production \/ Presentation: Rubin Fogel Productions"]

hits.title: Opening Gala with Dawn Tyler Watson
hits.content: To celebrate its 11th edition, Festival Stella Musica, under the artistic direction of pianist Katarzyna Musiał, opens with a vibrant evening bringing together outstanding women from different cultures, generations, and musical worlds. | This evening will be headlined by Dawn Tyler Watson. A JUNO Award winner and recipient of numerous prestigious distinctions, she is one of the leading voices of Canadian blues. She captivates audiences with her stage presence and her unique style, which blends blues, jazz, soul, gospel, and rock.She will be joined by exceptional guests, including Djely Tapa, a two-time JUNO Award-winning Canadian-Malian singer-songwriter who bridges West African traditions with contemporarysonorities. Coming from a family of griots, she blends West African musical traditions with contemporary sounds. Rachel Therrien, an internationally renowned, GRAMMY-nominated jazz trumpet player and composer; Cécile Doo-Kingué, an award-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter influenced by blues, soul, jazz, and Afro-roots; and the up-and-coming Montreal singer-songwriter Rachel Dara complete the lineup.From blues and jazz to West African influences, soul, and contemporary songwriting, this colourful evening celebrates artistic encounters, cultural diversity, and the power of women in music. | ["2h with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Stella Musica Festival"]

hits.title: Le fantôme dans la machine
hits.content: Invited onto a television set, Rousse gets the surprise of her life: the team has planned a live reunion with her brother, whom she hasn’t seen for 29 years.  | The problem is, he died in a fire in 1997. Is it a hallucination? A tasteless stunt? Are they trying to rattle her for the sake of “good TV”? But then her brother appears to her again in other unlikely places, to catch up, pick up the conversation where they left off, and tease her just like he used to. These encounters give Rousse a glimpse of the life she might have had if her brother had survived the tragedy, or, rather, the many versions of lives unlived that unfold in parallel universes. These discoveries come with unsettling questions: would she be willing to give up the life she has now to keep her beloved brother alive and by her side? Directed by Alexia Bürger (Les Hardings, Les filles du Saint Laurent, Camera obscura), who has shared a bond since childhood and a rich artistic partnership with author Fanny Britt (Bienveillance, Hurlevents, Classique(s)), this “auto-science-fiction” blurs the boundaries between fiction and reality, exploring the ways in which the dead continue to haunt the living. Between intimate confession and dramatic invention, both autobiographical and pure fabulation, this play about the power of imagination explores how writing and the stage are a chance to re-enact a formative tragedy of a life. With bittersweet irony, Britt and Bürger draw us into a world where memory and theatrical illusion intertwine to explore the stories we choose to believe. | ["French","November 12, 2026","November 13, 2026"] | ["Text: Fanny Britt","Stage Direction: Alexia Bürger","Interpretation: Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, Patrice Dubois, Simon Lacroix, Christophe Levac","Dramaturgy: Chloé Gagné Dion","Staging Assistance: Stéphanie Capistran-Lalonde","Scenography and Lighting Design: Martin Labrecque","Costumes: Elen Ewing","Music: Philippe Brault","Props: Julie Measroch","Makeup and hairstyling: Justine Denoncourt-Bélanger","Production \/ Presentation: Duceppe","Collaboration: Place des Arts"]
